# Open Backlog — pruned 2026-06-09

Pruned from 150 items to ~70 real items. Full document at [`tgp-agent-context/audits/OPEN_ISSUES_2026-06-09.md`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/tgp-agent-context/blob/main/audits/OPEN_ISSUES_2026-06-09.md).

**Removed as merged / superseded:** A.1–A.12 (PR-A), all 8 Cycle B RLS PRs (`3fa75ff`, `370a7ae`, `c94fa14`, …), AI gateway hardening (#327), payment-ops hardening (cursor pagination, throttles, transfer/payout webhook cases), HK-2..HK-6 wearables (through #364), and most of the 2026-05-26 28-finding register (A1/A3/A7/A9, B2/B3/B5/B6/B7/B8, SC-1/SC-2, EFF-2/EFF-3, CC-3/CC-4).

**Status keys:** ACTIVE (subagent in-flight) · OPEN · DEFERRED · STRATEGIC · RECURRING · FAR-HORIZON.

---

## 0. ACTIVE — Round-3 Tier-1 fixers (this session)

| ID | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **v1-4** | Community realtime + push + telemetry | Builder running (`v1_4_community_builder_mq6w5fwk`) |
| **BUG-R2** | Dedup legacy `MealPlansModule` routes → `real-meal-plans` canonical | Fixer running (`bug_r2_meal_plan_dedup_mq6wh9rs`) |
| **BUG-R3** | Block archive of `CoachPackage` with active recurring subscribers | Fixer running (`bug_r3_package_archive_guard_mq6whvla`) |
| **BUG-R4** | GDPR export → S3 presigned URL | **STOPPED** — `@aws-sdk/client-s3` not in `package-lock.json`; needs dep PR before re-dispatch |
| **BUG-R5** | GDPR scrub cancels Stripe subs | **STOPPED** — `StripeApiService.deleteCustomer` does not exist; `cancelSubscription` signature mismatches stub; correct service is likely `StripeConnectApiService` (used by `dunning.service.ts`); parent wiring decision required |

---

## 1. Round-3 bugs still genuinely OPEN

### Tier 1 (after current fixers land)

- **BUG-R4\*** — approve dep PR for `@aws-sdk/client-s3` + `@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner`, then re-dispatch fixer
- **BUG-R5\*** — wire `StripeConnectApiService` into `GdprScrubService` + `UsersModule`; `deleteCustomer` stays TODO
- **BUG-R1** — `attachManualVideoLink` at `scheduling-session-lifecycle.service.ts:494` never calls `notifications.createNotification`. DEFERRED: collides with v1-4 builder on `notification-kind.ts`; spawn after v1-4 merges.

### Tier 2 — Serious (need verification + fix)

- **BUG-S1** — Single push token per user; multi-device & reinstall silently break notifications. Likely needs `UserPushToken` 1:N table; re-check after v1-4.
- **BUG-S2** — Notifications accumulate forever — no TTL, no cap, no deletion job. Add scheduled prune + per-user cap.
- **BUG-S3** — GDPR export missing Purchases, Sessions, Bloodwork, AI data. Couple with BUG-R4 dep PR.
- **BUG-S4** — Community Wins have no content moderation. Defer to v1-5/v1-6 moderation pass.
- **BUG-S5** — No notification when coach assigns workout/meal plan. Wire `notifications.createNotification` in plan-assignment paths.

### Tier 3 — Notable gaps

- **BUG-N1** — `getAlerts()` has no cap; 200-client roster returns 200+ alerts. Add `take: 200` + cursor (same shape as `payment-ops.controller.ts:139`).
- **BUG-N2** — Check-in unique constraint prevents evening / multiple check-ins per day. Schema mutation; coordinate with mobile UX.
